pages.title: Void Star
pages.text: §lAcquisition: §r Crafted at a crafting table with 4 Obsidian, 4 Ender Pearls and 1 Chorus Fruit.$(br2)§lCondition: §r Works while in a Curios slot, or in the main hand / off hand.$(br2)Void Body: immune to fall damage and void damage.$(br)Return to the Abyss: falling into the void sends you back to your respawn point.$(br)Void Ripple: every 2 seconds, deals void damage to hostile mobs within 18 blocks.
The grid above shows the layout: obsidian in the corners, ender pearls on the edges, chorus fruit in the center.
